subject.title: [Bug]: github-copilot Claude models capped at 128k on published 2026.6.10 (PR #91728 not released yet)

question: Should live GitHub Copilot catalog metadata be the authoritative source for session/status context limits whenever discovery succeeds, even when bundled static catalog rows disagree?
rationale: Changing precedence across live provider catalogs, static fallback rows, config overrides, and release gating is compatibility-sensitive and needs owner intent plus live validation.

options.title: Make live metadata authoritative
options.body: Keep static rows only for discovery failure and prevent them from lowering a successful live Copilot context value across session/status budgeting.

options.title: Patch static Claude rows only
options.body: Update the bundled Copilot Claude manifest rows to 1M now but leave future metadata drift possible.

options.title: Add temporary user override
options.body: Allow a config contextWindow override as a workaround, accepting another public config surface.

recommendation.title: Make live metadata authoritative
recommendation.body: Keep static rows only for discovery failure and prevent them from lowering a successful live Copilot context value across session/status budgeting.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining observable failure is in context-runtime cache/status/session behavior rather than only Copilot catalog mapping.
